title: A Study of YL201 in Combination with Other Anti-Cancer Therapies in Patients With Advanced Solid Tumors
official: A Phase Ib/II, Multicenter, Open-Label Study to Evaluate Safety, Efficacy, and Pharmacokinetics of YL201 in Combination with Other Anti-Cancer Therapies in Patients with Advanced Solid Tumors
summary:
Main objective: Part 1
Primary Objectives
•	To assess the safety of YL201 in combination with atezolizumab 
•	To determine the maximum tolerated dose (MTD) for YL201 in combination with atezolizumab
Part 2
Primary Objectives 
•	To assess the anti-tumor activity of YL201 in combination with atezolizumab

interventions.name: Tecentriq 1 200 mg concentrate for solution for infusion

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Capable of providing written informed consent.
2. 18 years of age or older
3. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group performance status (ECOG PS) of 0 or 1
4. Pathologically confirmed diagnosis of ES-SCLC
5. No prior systemic anti-cancer treatment
6. Have at least 1 evaluable tumor lesion according to Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1
7. Adequate organ and bone marrow function
8. Life expectancy of ≥3 months
Exclusion criteria:
1. Any prior targeting B7H3 treatments
2. Uncontrolled infection that requires systemic therapy
3. Active hepatitis B virus (HBV) or hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection.
4. A history of severe hypersensitivity reactions to drug substances, inactive ingredients in the drug product, or other mAbs
5. Any prior therapy with TOP1 inhibitors or ADCs composed of TOP1 inhibitors
6. Undergone major surgery within 4 weeks before the first dose of study drug or expect major surgery during the study
7. Symptomatic or actively progressing brain metastases
8. Active or prior documented autoimmune, inflammatory disorders, or immune deficiency, autoimmune pneumonitis, and autoimmune myocarditis
9. Received any live vaccine within 4 weeks before the first dose of study drug
10. Received systemic steroids or other immunosuppressive therapy within 2 weeks prior to initiation of study treatment
11. Clinically significant concomitant pulmonary disease
12. Uncontrolled or clinically significant cardiovascular disease
